parallel.requirements: The parallel parent identified the bech32 CLI, mandatory ESM .mjs structure, manual argparse compatibility, Python repr formatting, no Python invocation, and a crucial no-total-length-cap behavior.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent owned reference discovery and harness construction first, then assigned the complete implementation and zero-mismatch differential verification to a workflow build child, with later audit, fix, and confirm phases planned.
parallel.implementation: No final implementation was produced in the captured artifact. The executed workflow children repeated environment, harness, and reference probes but did not leave /output/test2.mjs or library files before interruption.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The parent never received a completed workflow result and the official artifact copy found an empty file list instead of the expected test2.mjs entry point.
parallel.verification: The parent verified the reference executable and created golden harnesses, but all verification was against the oracle or probes; no delivered candidate was available for integrated verification.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The run timed out with an empty final response, a killed workflow, no captured deliverables, and an official result of 0 passed samples out of 70.

serial.requirements: The serial run recognized the same CLI and formatting requirements, probed bech32 vectors, argparse behavior, quote escaping, non-ASCII invalidity, and module/compliance constraints.
serial.plan_and_ownership: The single serial actor owned the full pipeline directly: probe the executable, write the module hierarchy, run differential checks, and return the code without delegation.
serial.implementation: It wrote /output/test2.mjs and library modules for charset lookup, polymod/checksum, bech32 decode/encode, Python repr formatting, and argparse-like parsing.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The artifact validator captured the entry file and six library files, so the final tree was coherent enough to run in the official evaluator.
serial.verification: It ran samples, BIP-173 cases, argparse checks, quote and non-ASCII probes, and a 450-case fuzz sweep, but the tests missed official cases affected by the total-length cap.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The delivered bech32 module kept MAX_LENGTH = 90 and rejected long valid reference inputs, so the current official evaluation still marked solution_passed false with 58 of 70 samples passed.

comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel inserted a workflow boundary and delayed implementation ownership until after parent preflight, while serial began direct implementation and delivery in one control flow.

comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote a complete module hierarchy and entry file, with bech32 logic, checksum, repr, and argparse components.

comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel lost the implementation lifecycle at the workflow boundary; serial's work stayed available to the same actor until final delivery.

comparison_dimensions.difference: The serial run integrated and placed files; the parallel run's shared /output state never received deliverables before capture.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel built a large oracle and golden baseline but never verified a submitted candidate because no candidate existed.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel consumed the full 2399-second agent budget and exited with timeout status, after several long sleeps waiting on workflow progress.

comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel closure was forced by timeout with no artifact; serial closed voluntarily with files but still failed correctness threshold.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed status evaluations make this a both_fail pair: parallel solution_passed is false with 0/70 samples, and serial solution_passed is false with 58/70 samples. The concrete score gap is that parallel never delivered files after a preflight-gated workflow timed out, while serial wrote and integrated a mostly working artifact. Serial's remaining failure is an ordinary implementation defect, notably the MAX_LENGTH total-length check shown in its final bech32 code, not a concurrency issue.
parallel_contributors: Parent reference probing and harness construction consumed the early budget before implementation workflow launch.
The implementation workflow was killed with result null and the artifact validator captured no files.
serial_contributors: The single actor wrote the module hierarchy and entry point directly into /output.
The delivered implementation passed many local differential checks but retained a total-length check that official tests rejected.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Serial's MAX_LENGTH = 90 rule in bech32Decode is inconsistent with the reference behavior discovered by parallel and accounts for remaining failed cases.
Parallel had no final implementation artifact, so there is no comparable algorithmic code defect in the submitted parallel tree.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: Supported comparative contributors for the score gap; both official outcomes are failures, so this is not a unique pass/fail root cause claim.
